Input: In the previous module the students formed groups, this module is about appropriately scoping a project. it should also look at the choice of platform, based on user audience and also platform constraints and capabilities. It should also cover tools that are appropriate for the different platforms. For this class we are focusing on Desktop App, mobile, and web applications - but there should be some information about additional platforms.

Covers how to define the scope of an HCI design project and how to evaluate the four target platforms — Android, iOS, Windows, and Web — to select the most appropriate one. Students produce a formal project description outlining goals, constraints, and chosen tools.
